title: Legacy-contract mixed self-play league 65k pilot
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: A 65k-hand Standard10-seeded FIFO league under the repaired legacy-v4 observation/action contract, mixing 25% current-policy self-play with replayable procedural and learned opponents, can generate stable learned-weight improvement while keeping 50k source-state mean TV below 0.10 and greedy disagreement below 0.15. A frozen archive must improve over the untouched parent on a fresh common-randomness multi-anchor internal panel before any Slumbot spend.
material_change: Scale the passed 9k mechanism smoke to 65,536 physical hands; replace the immutable fixed pool with one Standard10-seeded latest/FIFO pool that inserts a frozen learned snapshot every four updates; set self-play to 0.25 and procedural replacement to 0.50 among external-opponent hands; preserve low-LR all-policy-head PPO, source KL 0.1, exact legacy bridge execution, fixed deal stream, and checkpoint/session evidence.
baseline: Untouched exact Standard10 legacy bridge: fresh20k -24.5683 bb/100 CI[-42.8407,-6.2959]. The 9,013-hand mechanism smoke passed at mean TV 0.006001 and greedy disagreement 0.0061 but supplied no strength evidence. Historical imitation-only teacher fresh20k was about -18.5025 and is not treated as a validated route.

notes: No Slumbot is authorized by training completion alone. Freeze endpoint and iter4/8/12 archives, audit the session and tensor scope, then use an untouched common-randomness internal panel. External fresh-only testing requires a positive internal signal with no broad collapse.
The route is PPO/self-play/opponent-league learned-weight training, not imitation; Standard10 is initialization, execution anchor, and KL reference only.

Preflight collection error before trainer launch: two referenced test filenames did not exist. Zero environment hands and no training artifacts. Corrected focused suite uses the actual bridge/environment/dynamic-pool/procedural tests.

The fixed-pool auditor rejected the valid learned FIFO membership before writing an audit; zero evidence was modified. A record-local dynamic FIFO audit checks physical counters, assignment replay, source identity, membership cadence, optimizer state, metadata, and archives.

Before panel outcomes: fixed 5 candidates x 4 untouched anchors x 1,024 mirrored greedy pairs (40,960 physical evaluation hands). Promotion requires >=3/4 positive paired anchor points and pooled four-comparison Bonferroni 98.75% CI lower >0; select highest pooled point among passing archives. Otherwise no Slumbot.

Independent evidence audit recomputed all 50k drift rows and 20x1024 mirrored-pair cells, verified common decks and hashes, and explicitly added the omitted per-seat pooled-delta check. No archive passes the complete promotion rule, matching the original no-selection outcome.

result.summary: The Standard10-seeded legacy-contract mixed league completed 69,288 new physical hands with audited FIFO self-play/procedural training and low source drift. All four curve archives improved over parent on 3/4 internal anchors, but none cleared the preregistered multiplicity-adjusted lower-bound gate; no Slumbot hands were spent.
result.conclusion: This route is stable and shows a coherent positive internal signal, strongest at iter16 (+30.2183 bb/100 pooled) and iter08 (+26.8157), but both Bonferroni 98.75% lower bounds remained marginally below zero (-0.2125 and -0.0145). Because historical internal proxy ranking has not reliably predicted Slumbot, near misses are not promoted. The exact frozen iter08 and iter16 checkpoints merit one fresh-seed confirmatory replication, not optional continuation of this panel.
result.next_step: Preregister one independent fresh-deal replication of exact frozen iter08 and iter16 versus the same four untouched anchors, with two-candidate multiplicity correction and no reuse of discovery hands. Promote at most one checkpoint to fresh5k Slumbot only if the replication lower bound is positive, at least 3/4 anchors are positive, both seat points are nonnegative, and raw evidence audit passes.
